title: Molten Brownies

ingredients.item: g flaky sea salt, plus extra to garnish

steps: Prep. Preheat the oven to 175 °C. Grease and line a 20 cm tin.
Melt. Melt butter and chocolate over a bain-marie (bowl not touching the water).
Sugar. Off the heat, stir in sugar and salt with a wooden spatula (not a whisk) until dissolved; this also cools the mix.
Eggs. With the mix warm, not hot, whisk in the eggs one at a time until glossy.
Fold. Sift in flour and cacao and fold gently until just combined.
Bake. Pour into the tin, tap out air bubbles, top with flaky salt and bake 22 minutes until set on top and a skewer comes out slightly moist.
notes: The caption specifies organic ingredients, A2 butter and pasture-raised eggs.
